fields.value: Approximately 53 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). Retained same-phase trough spacing is approximately even in this brief window. Regular biphasic positive/deep-negative complexes preceded by small rounded positive bumps and followed by low recovery. Sinus bradycardia is a conditional teaching comparison; first-degree block is not established. Regular spacing near 53 and separated precomplex positive candidates support testing sinus origin. Restricted PR 0.19-0.28 s crosses 0.20; no constant prolonged PR, true P identity or full-strip one-to-one conduction is established. The selected QRS uncertainty envelope crosses 0.12 s and establishes no narrow/wide or normal/abnormal class. The conditional candidate PR envelope is not a confirmed PR measurement, physiological variation or evidence of first-degree block. The sinus comparison additionally requires sinus-compatible P morphology in a known lead and a verified atrial-to-ventricular sequence. The course sinus-bradycardia template also specifies a constant 0.12-0.20 s PR and QRS below 0.12 s; neither interval requirement is established by these candidate envelopes. This is a comparison to test, not a preferred diagnosis.
